Off that rig there is no window, every Paint returns a typed refusal and every proof string is empty - so a comparison keyed to the machine property would be two empty strings agreeing with each other about a surface that was never created, which is precisely the vacuity this list exists to prevent. skipSemantics: May-skip, not must-skip: a listed test that runs and passes on a machine where its precondition holds is green. Matching is exact on the pre-'(' portion of the TRX result testName (xunit theory rows serialize with arguments, e.g. Class.Method(x: 1)); a name with no parens matches whole. Anchor is the TRX result list, never Counters arithmetic.
admissionRule: allowedSkips is not a quarantine list. A test may be listed only when its precondition is a property of the machine or OS that cannot be satisfied by configuration during a contract run, and its change names the machine class where it executes. Two named PERMANENT BANS apply: (1) CcpClient.Tests.DataRootOverrideTests.DefaultSettingsPath_EnvUnset_IsThePlatformDefault must never be allowed to skip because a process-wide CCP_DATA_ROOT override makes the floor vacuous; (2) CcpClient.Tests.ChaosTunnelLoopbackTests.Logging_RouteClassesOnly_NeverFilenameOrQuery must be fixed at the source, never quarantined.
bumpRule: Bump total only in the same commit as the test change that moves the count, with the reason recorded here. Never widen, disable, or special-case a check to make a step pass. Adding a name to allowedSkips requires the admission rule above and the machine class where it executes.
lastMovedBy: +37 unit, headless unchanged at 280, across TWO lanes. LANE A - PRESET DEFAULT PARITY, AND MY OWN DEFECT REPORT WAS WRONG. I filed the spiral defaulting ON as a defect, inferring it from the fact that every sibling preset document defaults false. AppSettings.cs:2672 declares _spiralEnabled = true: UPSTREAM SHIPS IT ON, the port is faithful, and reading upstream settled in one line what an inference got backwards. Nothing changed; the value is pinned against upstream's so it cannot drift either way. THE SWEEP IT TRIGGERED IS WHERE THE VALUE WAS. Eleven modules agree. TWO REAL DISAGREEMENTS FELL OUT: MandatoryVideosEnabled ships TRUE upstream and FALSE in the port, and the port's own remarks assert 'Ships OFF' - a statement about upstream that upstream contradicts, which is worse than a wrong value because later readers trust comments. And MandatoryVideoSchedule.DefaultPerHour = 2 was taken from SLIDER MARKUP that is overwritten on load, so a fresh upstream install shows 6: A XAML LITERAL IS A DESIGN-TIME PLACEHOLDER, NOT A DEFAULT. Neither flipped; both pinned with both values so the decision is deliberate. SUBLIMINAL COLOURS: three routed through and resolved PER FIRING because that is where upstream resolves them, so a colour changed between two cards lands on the next one. SubBackgroundTransparent is REFUSED IN TYPE rather than faked - the surface composites one layered window at a single LWA_ALPHA over a B,G,R,X frame and there is no per-pixel 'absent' to write - with both upgrade routes named. SubTextTransparent is DELIBERATELY NOT PORTED because it is INERT UPSTREAM: the editor writes it and nothing in the WPF render path reads it, so porting it would ship a dial that moves nothing. THE WHITE-FLOOD HYPOTHESIS IS ELIMINATED with a quantified negative and a positive control: sixteen inputs, worst full-monitor near-white 1.51%, and an all-white palette reads 100% so the counter is not blind. BUT THE CARD CAN FLOOD - 96.25% non-background on a dense block phrase - IN THE TEXT COLOUR, and the ONLY thing preventing a white flood is the outline-under-text DRAW ORDER; the mutation swapping the two draw calls produces 95.78% near-white. Eliminated for the shipped build AND now guarded. LANE B - THE INK READ IS OFF THE BUBBLE MOVE PATH. The overlay's predicate 'nothing about the window changed' is false every frame for a bubble; the narrower one that is TRUE is that A MOVE DOES NOT CHANGE A WINDOW'S CONTENT, and the ink read asks about content. Each placement reads one eighth of the disc on a phase-advancing diagonal, the whole disc re-read outright on a target's first placement, after any read that found no ink, after an OS-driven WM_PAINT, and on every Observe. THE GUARANTEE SURVIVES BY CONSTRUCTION: the failure it exists to catch - on screen, absorbing clicks, showing nothing - is a WHOLE-SURFACE failure, and a target holding no ink holds none in every phase, so it is caught on the very next placement with ZERO added latency; only a partial loss on a still-visible bubble can take eight. Phases=8 is the largest value for which every phase samples the disc's central third at every legal size. Component measurement, labelled as such and NOT the product claim: Move median 10.01 ms to 2.35 ms, 4.3x, so three targets per step goes from 30.0 ms of placement work to 7.1 ms. THE ELAPSED-TIME HYPOTHESIS IS DEAD AND THAT IS A CLEAN NEGATIVE: both products apply a FIXED per-tick delta and neither integrates elapsed time, so slow rendering looks like SLOW MOTION in both and the port is faithful. A DIFFERENT divergence was found instead: upstream re-bases a free-running clock at the START of the step so its period is max(30, work), while the port re-schedules AFTER the work so its period is 30 + work - 60 ms against 30 before this change, 37.1 after. Left alone because it is the PORT-WIDE pattern rather than Bubble Pop's, and filed. A MUTATION WENT GREEN AND THE LANE CAUGHT ITSELF: its detail string's sweep arm contained the whole-disc arm's entire text, so a fact discriminating by substring was satisfied by both - the arms now share no phrase.
